name: Pomegranate wishes
rationale: A cut pomegranate turns an Azerbaijani symbol of abundance into wishes shared with someone you love.

name: A day circled
rationale: An open, hand-drawn circle singles out one day: someone important is already on your mind.

name: Kept in mind
rationale: A deeply folded page corner is the small physical gesture of marking something worth returning to.

name: Held close
rationale: Two open arms hold a person at their center, putting the recipient ahead of the gift.

name: A wish on its way
rationale: An angular paper bird carries the feeling of a personal note from one person to another.

name: Make a wish
rationale: One birthday candle captures the familiar pause before a person makes a wish.

name: A personal signature
rationale: A free-standing, handwritten double valley gives Wisher the informality of signing a card by hand.

name: Words for you
rationale: Two generous opening quotation marks make the personal words inside a greeting the identity.

name: A wish unfolding
rationale: One seed held in an opening leaf suggests a small thoughtful gesture growing into joy.
